testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-001 Open Year In Review on First App Launch
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Happy flow: First app launch → Year In Review intro story displays directly without user navigation
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Intro card visible with story title and welcome message
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: App launches directly to first story

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-002 Swipe Left Navigates to Next Story
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Mobile gesture: User swipes left on story → next story displays with smooth fade animation
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Next story loads with fade transition, story counter advances

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-003 Swipe Right Navigates to Previous Story
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Mobile gesture: User swipes right → previous story displays
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Previous story loads, story counter decrements
testcases.ExpectedError: No swipe action or visual feedback

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-004 Story Carousel UI Elements Visible
testcases.TestCaseDescription: UI validation: Story card, progress dots, story counter, and close button all visible
testcases.ExpectedElements: Story card, progress indicators, story counter (X/Y), close button, next/prev buttons

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-005 Tap on Story Card Advances to Next Story
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Mobile gesture: Tap (not swipe) on story → next story displays

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-006 Tap Left Side Goes to Previous Story
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Mobile gesture: Tap left side of story → previous story displays

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-007 Close Button Exits Story View
testcases.TestCaseDescription: User clicks close button → exits story view and returns to dashboard
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Story view closes, dashboard displayed, entry point shows completion ring

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-008 Android Back Gesture Exits Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Android: User presses back button → exits story view gracefully
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Story view closes, dashboard restored

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-009 Story Loads on Slow 3G Network
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Network condition: Data loads on slow 3G → loading indicator shown, story eventually loads
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Loading spinner shows, story loads within 10 seconds

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-010 Retry Button on Network Timeout
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Network error: API timeout → error message with retry button shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-011 View Cached Stories in Offline Mode
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Network: Device offline but story data cached → stories display from cache
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Stories display normally from cached data

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-012 Network Interruption During Load
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Network: Connection drops mid-load → graceful error handling with retry
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Loading stops, error message shown, can retry

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-013 Device Rotation Portrait → Landscape
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Orientation: User rotates device while viewing story → layout reflows, story continues
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Story content reflows to landscape, music continues, position maintained

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-014 Device Rotation During Story Animation
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Orientation: Device rotates while story animation playing → animation continues smoothly
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Animation continues uninterrupted, layout adapts smoothly

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-015 Multiple Device Rotations
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Orientation: User rotates device multiple times → state maintained, no crashes
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: App stable after multiple rotations, no memory leaks

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-016 Background Music Plays with Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Audio: Story starts → background music plays automatically respecting device volume
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Music plays from start to story completion

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-017 Music Respects Device Mute Setting
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Audio: Device on mute → music does not play even if story playing
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: No audio plays, story continues visually

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-018 Music Pauses on Incoming Call
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Audio: Incoming phone call → music pauses, resumes after call ends
testcases.ExpectedBehavior: Music paused immediately, story pauses too

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-019 Music Continues Across Story Navigation
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Audio: User swipes to next story → music continues playing uninterrupted
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Music does not restart or stop, flows continuously

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-020 Music Stops When Exiting Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Audio: User closes stories → background music stops
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Music stops immediately

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-021 Share Badge Story to Social Platforms
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Share: User clicks share on badge story → native share sheet opens
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Native share sheet opens with badge image

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-022 Share Summary Bento Story
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Share: User clicks share on summary story → bento layout image generated and shared
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Summary image generated and ready to share

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-023 Share Badge to WhatsApp
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Share: User selects WhatsApp → app switches to WhatsApp, image attached
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: WhatsApp opens with badge image as attachment

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-024 Handle Share Failure Gracefully
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Share: Image generation fails → error message shown, user can retry
testcases.ExpectedError: Could not generate share image. Try again?

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-025 Dismiss Share Sheet
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Share: User dismisses share sheet → returns to story
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Returns to story view

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-026 Android: In-App Rating Prompt After Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Native API: After story completion → Google Play in-app review prompt appears
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Native rating prompt appears after story completion

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-027 iOS: In-App Rating Prompt After Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Native API: After story completion → iOS SKStoreReviewController prompt appears
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Native rating prompt appears after story completion

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-028 User Rates Stories 5 Stars
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rating: User taps 5 stars → rating submitted to app store
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: 5-star rating submitted, thank you message shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-029 User Rates Stories 1-3 Stars
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rating: User rates 1-3 stars → feedback form or support link offered
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Low rating sent, feedback form offered instead of store submission

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-030 Dismiss Rating Prompt
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rating: User dismisses prompt → returns to dashboard, prompt won't show for 60 days
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Returns to dashboard, prompt won't show for 60 days

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-031 Rating Prompt Frequency Cap 60 Days
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Rating: User rated recently → new prompt won't appear for 60 days

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-032 Rapid Story Navigation Stability
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Performance: User rapidly swipes through stories → app remains stable, no crashes
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: App responsive, no lags, smooth transitions

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-033 Memory Stable During Long Story Viewing
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Performance: User views all stories continuously (10+ minutes) → memory usage stable
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: No memory leaks, app responsive after extended viewing

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-034 Story Images Load Without Memory Issues
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Performance: Large story images load → cached efficiently, no unnecessary reloads
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Images load quickly, no memory leaks

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-035 App Backgrounding and Restoration
testcases.TestCaseDescription: State: User backgrounds app during story, returns → story resumes from same position
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Story resumes from same point, music restarts if paused

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-036 Screen Lock During Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: State: Device screen locks while viewing stories → music pauses, story stops
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Music pauses, story pauses, resumes on unlock

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-037 Joining Date Story Shown (DOJ in 2025)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Data validation: User joined in 2025 → joining date story displayed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Joining date story displayed with correct date and tenure

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-038 Joining Date Story Hidden (DOJ Not in 2025)

testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Joining date story not displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-039 Anniversary Story Shown (>1 Year Service)

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-040 Promotion Story Shown (Promoted in 2025)

testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Promotion story shown with new designation

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-041 Marriage Story Shown (Married in 2025)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Data validation: User married in 2025 → marriage story displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-042 Child Birth Story Shown (Dependent DOB in 2025)

testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Attendance streak story displayed with streak count

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-044 Recognition Story (5+ Recognitions)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Data validation: User has 5+ recognitions given/received → recognition story displayed

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-045 Rising Star Badge Assigned (Promoted in 2025)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User promoted in 2025 → Rising Star badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-047 Esteemed Veteran Badge (10+ Years Service)

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-048 Goal Crusher Badge (75%+ Completion)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User with 75%+ goal completion → Goal Crusher badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-049 Streak Achiever Badge (30+ Attendance Days)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User with 30+ attendance streak → Streak Achiever badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-050 Referral Ninja Badge (3+ Activated Referrals)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User with 3+ successful referrals → Referral Ninja badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-051 Travel Titan Badge (7+ Days Business Trips)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User with 7+ days business travel → Travel Titan badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-052 Cheer Champion Badge (5+ Vibe Posts)
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Persona assignment: User with 5+ Vibe interactions → Cheer Champion badge shown

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-053 Summary Bento Story with 4 Data Points
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Summary layout: User with 4 eligible data points → bento layout with 4 cards shown
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Summary story displays 4-point bento layout

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-054 Summary Bento Story with 5 Data Points
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Summary layout: User with 5 eligible data points → bento layout with 5 cards shown
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Summary story displays 5-point bento layout

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-055 Summary Bento Story with 6 Data Points
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Summary layout: User with 6+ eligible data points → bento layout with 6 cards shown (max)
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Summary story displays 6-point bento layout (first 6 considered)

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-056 User with No Eligible Stories
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Data validation: New employee/no eligible data → intro card only, message shown
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Intro card displayed, message: 'Come back next year with more highlights'

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-057 Entry Point Ring Color Changes on Completion
testcases.TestCaseDescription: UI: User completes all stories → dashboard entry point ring color changes to indicate completion
testcases.ExpectedUIChange: Ring color changes from blue to gold/completed state

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-058 Screen Reader Story Navigation
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Accessibility: Screen reader enabled → all story content announced, swipe described
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Story title, content, and next/previous actions announced by screen reader

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-059 Text Scaling on Story Content
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Accessibility: System text scale 150% → story text scales, content remains readable
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Text scaled properly, no truncation, layout reflows

testcases.TestCaseName: TC-YR-060 High Contrast Color Mode
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Accessibility: High contrast enabled → story content has sufficient contrast
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Text and UI elements have high contrast

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Accessibility: Close button, skip button, etc. are 48dp minimum → easily tappable

testcases.TestCaseDescription: Localization: User language set to French → story content displays in French
